deficiencies.description: The rewrite introduces a causal link with the conjunction 'since', asserting that the terminology is used because surgeons can tell by touch, whereas the original text only used 'where' to describe the situation in which it is used.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: And you'll hear this kind of terminology even now, where a surgeon can see just by holding or touching a tumor, whether or not it's movable or immovable.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: This terminology is still heard now, since a surgeon can tell just by holding or touching a tumour whether it is movable or immovable.
deficiencies.caseForForbidden: The conjunction 'since' introduces an unsourced causal link explaining why the terminology persists, which was not explicitly stated in the source text.
deficiencies.caseForAllowed: The use of 'since' is a natural interpretation of the speaker's colloquial use of 'where' to connect the persistent use of the terminology to clinical practice.
